title: Refuse task-sync user instructions on status and disable
outcome: Refuse task-sync user instructions on status and disable
acceptance: The shared settings operation refuses a non-null user_instruction when action is status or disable, before creating or changing any settings path, with a clear argument refusal.
Regression tests exercise MCP and the shared service for both actions with an instruction, verify the refusal and unchanged settings bytes/path inventory, and retain successful enable behavior.

completion.summary: Status and disable refuse non-null task-sync user instructions through the shared service, preserving read-only precedence, settings bytes/path inventory and enable/null behavior.
